name: home-decision-journal
metric_note: Deliberately none. An optimisation loop here fails five of six gates; G4 catastrophically, because a loop optimising backtested return finds leverage, concentration and survivorship bias.
stopping_condition: One pass per open decision per week. Review dates are scheduled, not looped.
honest_metric: Calibration - how often recorded reasoning proves right for the reason written down. Accumulates over years. There is no weekly number.
immutable_paths_note: Closed journal entries are immutable. Editing what you believed after learning the outcome destroys the only thing the journal is for.
forbidden: recommend a specific security, allocation, or transaction
produce a return estimate, probability, or expected value
touch a brokerage, bank, payment, or payroll surface
read a lane it was not given
